=Extract only what is written in the CV. Never infer, never add
anything that is not on the page. Return JSON only, no prose, no code fences:
{"roles": [{"title": "", "company": "", "start": "", "end": ""}],
 "skills": [], "education": [], "parse_warnings": []}

Put anything you could not read cleanly into parse_warnings.

{{ $json.cv }}

=Extract only what is written in the job ad. Never infer.
Return JSON only, no prose, no code fences:
{"must_have": [], "nice_to_have": [], "years_required": 0}

must_have and nice_to_have hold concrete tools, technologies or languages only,
one or two words each, like "Kubernetes" or "Terraform". Never a sentence, never
a job function such as "backend services", and never an amount of experience -
years belong in years_required.

JOB AD:
{{ $json.job_ad }}
